info.name: Ticketing System - Complete Workflow
info.description: Event ticketing microservices platform. All requests run against locally launched services (gateway 8080, event 8081, venue 8082, reservation 8083, payment 8084, ticket 8085, notification 8086, analytics 8087, user 8088) and Keycloak (8180). Auth (Keycloak) is optional for workflows because the platform ships with app.security.enabled=false.

item.name: 01 - Authentication
item.description: user-service is a profile registry only; real auth is Keycloak (realm 'ticketing'). The client 'ticketing-api' is public (PKCE) with Direct Access Grants DISABLED, so the password-grant Login below only returns a token after you enable it in the Keycloak admin console (Realm ticketing > Clients > ticketing-api > Settings > 'Direct access grants' ON). The whole platform runs with app.security.enabled=false, so every API workflow works WITHOUT a token.

item.name: Login (OIDC Password Grant)
item.description: Needs Direct Access Grants enabled on the ticketing-api client (disabled by default). Seeded demo customer: customer@yeab.com / Change123!

item.name: 02 - Venue
item.description: Create a venue, then import its seats. Seat availability is not a separate query - it is enforced atomically at hold time (409 SEAT_ALREADY_RESERVED).

item.name: 03 - Event
item.description: Events are created DRAFT and must be PUBLISHED before seats can be held (the workflow below will 422 otherwise).

item.name: Get Event Seats (availability)
item.description: No dedicated seat-availability endpoint exists; seat occupancy is enforced atomically at hold time (409 SEAT_ALREADY_RESERVED, auto-released on hold expiry). This lists the venue's seats for the event window.

item.name: 04 - Reservation
item.description: Hold is atomic and idempotent (Idempotency-Key header). Prices are computed server-side. Holds auto-expire after 10 minutes (scheduler releases seats).

item.name: Expired Hold (auto-release check)
item.description: There is no manual expire endpoint: un-confirmed HOLDs auto-transition to EXPIRED after 10 minutes and their seats are released. Replace {{expiredReservationId}} with a held reservation left for >10 minutes and confirm it reads EXPIRED.

item.name: 05 - Payment
item.description: Provider is 'mock' by default (app.payment.provider). amount must EXACTLY equal the reservation totalAmount and currency must match. Webhook signature = HMAC-SHA256 of the RAW body using {{webhookSecret}} (precomputed for you in the Webhook request).

item.name: 06 - Ticket
item.description: In production, tickets are issued via the payment.successful Kafka event. POST /api/tickets is a dev path. QR endpoint returns image/png bytes encoding the ticket code.

item.name: 07 - Notification
item.description: The async chain auto-sends an EMAIL notification ('Your tickets are ready') after ticket issuance via notification.requested. This folder queries and manually triggers it.

body.raw: {"idempotencyKey":"manual-{{$guid}}","customerId":"{{userId}}","channel":"EMAIL","recipient":"{{customerEmail}}","subject":"Manual test","message":"This is a manual notification sent from Postman."}

item.name: 08 - Analytics
item.description: Analytics is fed by Kafka (reservation/payment/ticket/event/notification topics). The data surface is overview + summary; each 'report' below reads the relevant metric from those endpoints.

exec: console.log('totalRevenue=' + ov.totalRevenue + ' confirmedReservations=' + ov.confirmedReservations + ' tickets=' + ov.ticketsGenerated);

item.name: 09 - E2E COMPLETE WORKFLOW
item.description: Run 1-14 sequentially. Steps capture IDs into collection variables automatically (chaining). Works with or without auth (SECURITY_ENABLED=false). Note: after payment success the reservation->tickets->notification chain is asynchronous (~25s); if step 11-13 look unprocessed, wait and re-run them.

item.name: 11 Payment Webhook (signed)
item.description: Informational: payment already SUCCEEDED via step 10, so this re-confirms the signed webhook contract. To test the webhook as the sole completion path, skip step 10 and use this instead.

exec: console.log('E2E summary -> revenue=' + ov.totalRevenue + ' confirmedReservations=' + ov.confirmedReservations + ' tickets=' + ov.ticketsGenerated);
